description: Web component definition for 'iron-localstorage', a Polymer element that provides an interface to the Web Storage API (localStorage), keeping a property in sync with localStorage, with support for JSON serialization, event handling, and auto-save features.

classes.name: Polymer
classes.description: Main Polymer object used to define the custom element 'iron-localstorage'.

methods.name: _handleStorage
methods.description: Handles 'storage' events to reload data if the relevant key changes.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current value to localStorage, handling JSON serialization and errors.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the value from localStorage, optionally triggered by external changes.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Internal method to load data from localStorage, parse JSON if needed, and fire events.
